subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the Indian Association established in Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1876__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On July 26, 1876,** Surendranath Banerjee** along with **Anand Mohan Bose** formed the** **Indian Association in ** Kolkata**.
 
• He was inspired by Mazzini and wanted an India unified in the matter of political aspiration and program.
 
• It promoted the fraternity between Hindus and Muslims and demanded political reforms. 
 
• In the year **1886**, the Indian Association merged with the **Indian National Congress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
